A search for the variant glasmail shows one dead mark: GLASMAIL, serial 74299521, class 038 (computer services, a network for the transmission of messages), owner Tides Foundation, filed 1992-07-29, Dead/Cancelled 2000-12-23. A dead conflicting mark is a caution under the decision rule. Secondary aggregator, not a register.
